$comment: TWO-STEP stories with THREE-DIGIT numbers (Year pages T, 2026-11-14; 3.OA.D.8 two-step problems, adding and subtracting within 1,000; de 'Sachaufgaben mit zwei Rechenschritten bis 1000', sv 'textuppgifter i två steg 0–1000'): the four step pairs of two-step-frames.js (A + then − · B − then + · C + then + · D − then −), each told where hundreds of one thing are believable: a store with a delivery truck, a market, workers who pack, a truck that delivers. Nobody is named: 356 pencils belong to no child. Slots: {n1} {n2} {n3} {noun}, {Q} = how many, agreeing (es, pt, it). The thing is named after the first number and after 'how many' only. Read by a native reader (2026-11-14). Only the two-step page within 1,000 reads this file.
